findings.title: The smoke run fails the node_count_growth gate, and the smoke's exit code ignores gated checks
findings.detail: In the committed dev_rows.json, and again in my rerun, node_count_growth FAILS: the minimum ratio is 6.71 against a lower bound of 6.80, on the coarsest step of Cases 1a/2/3 and the manufactured case. The smoke exits 0 whenever the integrity checks pass, so this DoD command cannot catch a regression in any post-solve gate. The pass branch of node_count_growth was never run end to end on frozen-rule grids. The level-to-level DOF ratios recorded in the T0243 dev study for the frozen rule are inside the band (7.25 to 7.81), so I expect the registered run to pass this gate, but the deliverable does not show it.
findings.evidence: dev_rows.json meta.checks: node_count_growth passed=False, value=6.7118, threshold=6.8. Dev-study DOFs: case1b 160173->1221025->9529569 (7.62, 7.80); mms 28683->207837->1577913 (7.25, 7.59); fresh plan 251523->1855630->14225251 (7.38, 7.67).
findings.suggested_check: Before registration, assert node_count_growth on the dev-study frozen-rule DOF counts with the same lo/hi computation the runner uses.

findings.title: Design note gives the wrong range for frozen-rule node growth
findings.detail: Sec. 9 says the frozen rule measured 7.25-7.62 (T0243). The DOF counts in research/o007_dev3/dev_study.json give up to 7.805 (case1b L1->L2), 7.77 (case1a) and 7.76 (N-layer). Every value is still inside [6.8, 9.2], so no gate is affected; only the documentation is wrong.
findings.suggested_check: Correct the range in research/notes/o007-e009-design.md sec. 9.

findings.title: F5 works only through A3's ref_gci_cap and is not a gated sanity check
findings.detail: The objective's F5 detection text says 'gated check'. The spec makes F5 informational and folds it into A3, where any die with L2 GCI > 0.25 K makes A3 +inf. This gives the response the objective prescribes (A3 not met, INCONCLUSIVE, no redraw), and the note discloses it. I confirmed the runner's per-row a3_ratio applies the cap exactly as mfos.metrics.max_gci_consistency does. Anyone checking the sanity-check list against the objective text should know that F5 is not on it.
findings.evidence: E009.yaml metric max_l2_gci_K: 'F5 (NOT gated)'; recompute params ref_gci_cap: 0.25; e009_run.run_layout ratio = inf if s['gci'] > cap.

findings.title: Lint edit outside the listed deliverables
findings.detail: Design note sec. 11.3 discloses a lint-only edit to research/scripts/e002_runner_harness.py (three '# noqa: E402' lines now present). The file is not among the four deliverables. It is not a protected path, and the change is said to be behaviour-neutral. I did not verify that, because the snapshot has no parent commit to diff against.
findings.suggested_check: Diff research/scripts/e002_runner_harness.py against main and confirm the statements and their order are unchanged.

independent_checks_performed: Recomputed the sha256 of research/o007_dev3/frozen_config.json: 0226b770…120e9a, equal to the spec's fem_rule_file_sha256.

Ran `uv run mfos exp check E009 --rows research/e009/dev_rows.json`: exit 0. A1 0.0063 satisfied; A2/A3/A4 not satisfied on the smoke grids; the constant-k null fails A1 (0.0251) and A2 (2.52 K), so F3 discriminates.
Ran `uv run ruff check experiments/runners research`: all checks passed.

Re-implemented the order-capped GCI from the D0012/D0013 branch definitions in a scratch script, without importing mfos, and applied it to all 106 rows. Row gci and l2_gci agree to 1e-12 with zero mismatches. Each crosscheck row's a3_ratio (including the F5 ref_gci_cap = 0.25, the inf sum and the zero-sum cases) matches my recomputation. T_fem == fem_lv2 and tj_l2 == l2_lv3 on every row.

Reran the full smoke pipeline into $TMPDIR (exit 0, about 7 min, at most 2.4 GB RSS). All value columns (fem_lv0-2, l2_lv1-3, T_ref, dT_const_k, power_w) reproduce the committed dev_rows.json to at most 1.65e-10 K. Metrics are identical and the same single gate fails (node_count_growth).

Checked by code reading that _layer_means orders elements the same way as thermal_fem._build_mesh (np.nonzero(g.mat >= 0)). FEM._materials returns one entry per layer, so the F3 constant-k null uses true layer means. The constant-k path fixes k through g.kfun, and its Picard residual is correctly left out of picard_converged.
Checked that solve_layout builds its grid with the same layout_grid(...) call the runner uses for layer means and preflight, so the grid behind the null and layer means is the grid that was solved.

Checked that the smoke L2 overrides (H0_MAX, LAT_FRAC, EDGE_FRAC, Z_CELLS) are real module-level constants in thermal_layout, read at call time. The setattr coarsening therefore takes effect: the L2 growth in the smoke is 8.0.

Checked that ExperimentRun.metric stores float(value) with no finiteness check, so a +inf A3/A4 (the designed F5 outcome) cannot crash the registered run. mfos.metrics._finite_rows still fails closed on non-finite input columns.

Computed the frozen-rule per-level DOF growth from dev_study.json for every case and both dev layouts, plus the fresh-layout plan: 7.25 to 7.81, inside node_count_growth's [6.8, 9.2]. The preflight check passes (81 GB FEM, 131 GB FV, against 217.6 GB usable on n2-highmem-32).
caveats: The smoke rows show only that the pipeline works, on coarsened grids. They are not evidence that the frozen rule meets A1/A2/A4; that rests on the T0243 dev study, which I did not re-run.

The sandbox denied the DoD's two inline `python -c` assertion commands (frozen-config/spec equality and the spec key-string list) when I ran them as one compound command. Config equality is confirmed indirectly by the runner's fem_rule_frozen check passing in my rerun (it compares config.fem_rule with the frozen file). I did not run the key-string assertion myself.

The post-solve gates that fail on the smoke grids (node_count_growth) and the +inf A3/A4/F5 values have only been exercised on coarse grids. Behaviour at the frozen rule (growth band, F5 margin at L2 levels 1-3 on the fresh layouts) is inferred from the dev study and the L2 preview, not demonstrated by these deliverables.
I could not compare the review snapshot (single commit, no parent) with main, so I cannot rule out unlisted edits to other files beyond the disclosed lint edit.
